QuestInfo.name: Secret Rendezvous
QuestInfo.0: #b#p2111008##k made the Matter Disassembler that #b#p2111007##k was asked to make. Return to #p2111007# and give him the Matter Disassembler.
QuestInfo.1: #b#p2111007##k wants you to give the Matter Disassembler to the client at #b#m260020620##k in his place. This might be a good chance to get some more information on the core.
QuestInfo.2: Looks like the secret organization wants to use the core for evil, but only your family can tap its power. Why did #b#p9270084##k let you live despite knowing this fact?

0.0: The Matter Disassembler is done... a little early at that! I suppose I have you to thank for the extra business I'll surely receive.
0.1: Would you be a lamb and see this through to the end? My client likes to be discreet, as you've seen, and I stand out in a crowd. I believe you would be an excellent candidate for deliverying the Matter Disassembler you were so instrumental in building.

yes.0: That's the entrepreneurial spirit! If this goes well, I'll give you a generous cut of the profits... Net, not gross. I have a business to run here.
yes.1: The delivery instructions I was given told me to find a portal in #b#m260020620##k. Sounds spooky, but I'm sure you'll survive.
yes.2: Just keep your eyes open and do not drop that thing!

no.0: Come on, you did all that other stuff! Don't leave me hanging!

yes.0: I was sure you'd attempted to run off. Where is my money?
yes.1: Why are you just staring at me? Where is the money?! What did you do?!
yes.2: I should have known better than to trust a ruffian like yourself with this sort of delicate work. I lost so many mesos on this deal!!

npc.0: The delivery instructions I was given told me to find a portal in #b#m260020620##k. Sounds spooky, but I'm sure you'll survive.
